items.title: Engagement with independent schools 2026–27
items.summary: This presentation outlines HMIE’s approach to engagement with independent and grant-aided schools in Scotland during 2026–27.It covers:- Changes to the routine inspection programme.- New governance, safeguarding and child protection inspections.- Annual check-ins with link inspectors.- Early learning and childcare inspections and the Quality Improvement Framework.- Safeguarding and child protection guidance and resources.- Preparing for inspection, with a focus on learning, teaching and assessment (QI 2.3) and wellbeing, equality and inclusion (QI 3.1).Find out more at https://educationinspectorate.gov.scot
